newsitem.title: CHINA: South China city to upgrade port by 2005.
newsitem.headline: South China city to upgrade port by 2005.

text.p: China's southern boomtown of Guangzhou is to turn its port into an international shipping centre with annual capacity of 100 million tonnes of cargo by 2005, the China Daily said on Thursday.
The municipal government was seeking more than five billion yuan of investment for the project, it said.
City authorities were trying to attract foreign investment and planning to sell plots of land to raise funds, it said.
The project would involve building or reconstructing 32 wharfs with 77 berths along the Pearl River, it said.
The port would also include a passenger terminal, container handling facilities and warehouses, it said.
